visualCharacteristics: Rounded ice-blue card on the grid with a brand-name link, brand logo and abstract paragraph.
contentPattern: Cells classified by content: paragraph with a link = title link, picture = logo, other paragraphs = abstract (typically 3 single-cell rows).
usage: Use to close a case study with the brand boilerplate card (name link, logo and abstract).
reuseGuidance: Reuse at the end of case-study pages with the same link, logo and abstract rows; use top0/bot0 to tune spacing.
